title: Nourishing Jamaican Callaloo Salad
description: A flavorful and nutritious salad made with callaloo, a staple leafy green in Jamaican cuisine. This recipe combines the earthy taste of callaloo with the crunch of jamaican salad and the nutty flavor of nourishing ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine callaloo, jamaican salad, and nourishing greens.
Slice the avocado and add it to the bowl.
Squeeze the lime juice over the salad and toss to combine.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salad and season with salt to taste.
